text:
alex: Quick design check — thinking about reducing 'diff density' in the version timeline. current problem: heavy stacked changes make canary risk unclear. can we surface a compact risk metric + short microcopy?

jamal: agree. users scan quickly; a single compact label like ‘risk: low/med/high’ next to version chip would help.

maria: accessibility note: if we use color-only for risk, screen readers won't get it. we should include `aria-label` text and an explicit word. e.g., "Risk: Medium" visible/readable.

alex: yep — proposal: tiny pill with icon + word. hover shows breakdown: % traffic, recent errors, model change type.

tamika: love the hover breakdown but worried about hover-only access on keyboard/mobile. can we make the breakdown available on click or focus?

jamal: for keyboard: on focus show the same popup. for mobile: tap toggles the expanded view inline (accordion).

ethan: from eng side: we can compute a simple risk score server-side: weighted sum of recent error rate, canary delta from baseline, and size of config change. something like: `risk = 0.5*err_score + 0.3*delta_score + 0.2*config_score`

alex: nice. microcopy options for the pill: 1) `Risk: Low` 2) `Low risk` 3) `Low • 2% traffic` — which reads best?

jamal: prefer `Low • 2%` — short and scannable. but for SR we still need full label; maybe `Low` visually + hidden text `Risk: Low — 2% traffic`.

maria: exact SR text suggestion: `Risk level: Low. Canary traffic: 2%. Recent error rate: 0.1%.` keep sentences short.

tamika: microcopy for rollback CTA when risk high: current "Rollback" feels abrupt. suggestion: `Rollback (revert to vX)` or `Pause rollout & revert` — gives clearer action.

alex: good point. also add an emphasized warning when risk >= high: `This rollout shows elevated errors. Consider pausing or reverting.`

ethan: can we include a quick link to the last failing log for SRE in the popup? small anchor like `View last failure` that opens errors panel.

jamal: yes. but limit to one quick link to avoid clutter. keep the popup under 300px wide.

ui-bot: uploaded image  (screenshot) — https://img.redwood/snapshots/diff-density-proposal.png

alex: screenshot looks good. a couple layout nits: 1) the risk pill pushes the timestamp on narrow screens; 2) need consistent vertical spacing between version chips.

maria: a11y checklist: ensure pill has role="status" when risk changes, provide polite live region updates for `Risk level` changes; keyboard focus order must not trap users in popups.

tamika: copy thread: small line under timeline: `Tip: risk estimates are heuristic. Use logs and metrics before reverting.` where should this live? under the timeline or in the hover?

jamal: put it under the timeline as muted helper text — visible but subtle. also add a `Learn more` link to docs.

alex: final ask: jamal, can you mock both the compact inline pill and expanded popup states? include keyboard and mobile variants. maria — write the SR text snippets. ethan — share a simple pseudo formula for risk with threshold buckets (low < 0.3, med < 0.6, high >= 0.6). tamika — draft rollback CTA options (short + verbose).

jamal: will do, aiming for mock by EOD.

maria: SR snippets coming in 30m.

ethan: will post risk calc and test data later today.

tamika: I'll compile CTA options and edge-case copy.

alex: perfect — thanks team :thumbsup:

jamal: quick follow-up: should we include historical risk trend sparkline in the popup? helps judge volatility.

alex: yes if it doesn't clutter — 1-line sparkline only.

maria: ensure sparkline has an accessible text alternative like `Risk trend: rising` or `stable`.

jamal: got it. adding to mock.

alex: ok locking this thread for now. we'll iterate on the mock.

ui-bot: reminder set — review mock @ 15:30 in #design-review
